description: Per close of a segment, minepoa's engine fold one close at a time: established before, added (not already established), removed (pardons honoured), after and net. With close=, the added and removed addresses. CSV at /api/v1/governance/standing-changes.csv. Use it to see who became or stopped being established at each close.

close.description: one close: adds added_list and removed_list

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

name: get_standing_changes
title: Standing changes per close
